hero.title: See the hooks that keep you scrolling
hero.description:
HookLens labels addictive design on the feed itself — infinite scroll, badges, autoplay, rabbit holes.
Not Screen Time. Not a blocker. A name tag on the trap.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Straight answers for the first weekend.

items.question: Is this Screen Time or an app blocker?
items.answer: No. Those cut access. HookLens labels the addictive UI patterns in place so you can see the trap.

items.question: Does it work on every site?
items.answer: Not in v0. The hackathon wedge is an allowlisted Reddit demo. Universal scan is the long-term story.

items.question: Do you upload my browsing data?
items.answer: The planned extension analyzes locally in the browser. This marketing site does not need your Reddit session.

items.question: What is Twin mode?
items.answer: Addicted keeps labels on the hooks. Detoxed mutes engagement chrome on the currently loaded viewport, with an honest Feed pause banner for infinite scroll.
